name: First draft
description: An open book drawn in rough, doubled pencil lines, still unfinished, with a green pencil lying across it, its point resting at the end of the newest line of text.
choices: The self-drawing cracktro: outline only, no fills, a doubled line that skips like chalk on grain, and the pencil caught mid-stroke
The blue paper is left out so the sketch sits straight on the page, in navy on light and cream on dark
typography: DejaVu Sans Bold, plain outlined wordmark
